picks.analysis: SWKS scores -12.1 — a Put recommendation. The bearish read is led by Narrative (-6), reinforced by Mechanicals (-3.4). The biggest contributors are Macro Regime (-6, risk-off), Put/Call Ratio Extreme (-2.1, 0.24 P/C), Guidance (-1.2, -15.5%). Cutting the other way: MA Stack (20/50/100D) (+1, 2/3 above), Open Interest (C/P) (+0.9, 3.74x C/P). Within Semiconductors, the next-closest same-direction peer is AVGO at -10.1 — well below SWKS's -12.1 (SWKS leads on Fundamentals (-1.7 vs +0.6) and Mechanicals (-3.4 vs -1.5)), so SWKS is the cleaner puts expression. The suggested puts sit ~5.3% from spot with 74d to expiry, delta -0.52, mid $10.10 — a near-the-money Δ 0.45-0.65 contract (survives noise) inside the premium (≤ the larger of $35 or 12% of spot) / standard-monthly criteria.
